mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (id, user_id, session_uuid, session_title, status, message_count, last_message, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{sessionUuid}, #{sessionTitle}, #{status}, #{messageCount}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY last_message_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY last_message_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_session SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, message_count = #{messageCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_session ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM ai_chat_session GROUP BY status
